activity_summary: Burbage had split a seam at the elbow in the gesture he uses for Richard of Gloucester. Edith made him do it again, slowly, and showed him with her two hands how much cloth it takes. You moved the entrance a step later. She said a changed direction is cheaper than a changed sleeve only if she is told before the cutting. He did the gesture a third time, smaller, and liked it better. Sam stood through the measuring.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Measured the cloth with her two hands, required notice before a cutting, and took the sleeve.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Did the gesture a third time, smaller, and liked it better.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Stood through the measuring, and was glad of a principal corrected in cloth.

facets.activity: Moved an entrance and gave the sleeve to Edith

quotes.speaker: edith_kettlewood
quotes.text: Changing a direction is cheaper than changing a sleeve, Master Shakespeare, only if somebody tells me before the cutting.
